title: ReportMeStats
description: report.me-stats@1: one person's numbers across OpenVibe, on OpenVibe.Report (the owner, 2026-11-09: 'a section for most used, your most used platforms across all of them, with OpenVibe.Report analysis for you… show your stats… you can make them public if you want, but private by default'). GET /api/v1/me/stats answers the person their session names, with every section; GET /api/v1/u/:name/stats answers only the sections they published, and never a section they did not. A section a source did not answer for is absent, never an invented zero. The document is the same on both routes so the menu, the page and the public page read one shape.

generated_at.description: When the snapshot was counted. A public answer may be older than the request: it is the owner's last computed snapshot, so the page says when.

window.description: The window the counts were taken over. days is 7, 30 or 90; from and to are UTC calendar days.

published.description: Which sections the person made public. All false is the default: their /u/<name> page then shows none of their numbers.

sections.description: The counts, one key per publishable section. On GET /api/v1/me/stats every section a source answered for is here; on GET /api/v1/u/:name/stats only the published ones are.

note.description: One plain line about what is not in the counts, when a source could not answer. Never a count and never a claim that a number is zero.

site.description: One OpenVibe site the person used. visits is Network's own cross-site history count: a page is one visit, and the same page within ten minutes is the same visit. It is not a duration, and the contract has no minutes field until a source counts them.

service.description: The site id from Network's history, e.g. live, community, chat.

url.description: A page on the site, so the menu can draw the site's app icon.

icon.description: The site's icon id when Network's history names one.

week.description: This week's sites, most visited first.

month.description: This month's sites, most visited first.

top.description: The eight most visited this month: what the menu's Most used row draws.

activity.description: What the person touched, as days. A day with no history row is 0 because Network answered with its history: an unavailable history is an absent section.

weeks.description: Twelve weeks, oldest first; each week starts on its Monday (UTC).

active_days.description: Days in the window with at least one visit.

streak_days.description: Consecutive days with a visit, ending today (UTC), counted from the history.

made.description: Things the person made, one row per thing a source answered for. A thing with no source is absent, never 0.

ai.description: The person's own AI calls, from Report's AI meter (report.ai-usage-me-result@2's totals). Report quotes the meter; it never derives a price.

tokens.description: Input and output tokens added, as the meter counts them.

money.description: Vibes that reached the person, as OpenVibe.Billing answered them. Report stores no money and derives no amount.
